alex_pm: Quick sync — minimal onramp for private deploys (VPC/on-prem). Field asks condensed. Need to nail launch criteria + tradeoffs. TL;DR: aim for 'slim installer' MVP that preserves egress IP, supports offline bundle, optional KMS later. Thoughts?

cara_field: Agree. Customers will accept no KMS in v1 if we provide clear offline + upgrade story. Main ask: egress IP preservation + simple rollback.

ben_eng: Tech notes: can do slim installer by making telemetry opt-out and removing KMS dependency from bootstrap. Spike to confirm: 3 sprints conservative, 1 sprint optimistic. Risk: automated upgrades harder without KMS.

dan_ops: Propose launch criteria: 1) 2 pilot customers onboarded + success signoff, 2) install/uninstall runbook + rollback tested, 3) egress IP preserved on AWS/GCP/Azure, 4) model pinning supported. Budget: we need field resources for 2 pilots.

alex_pm: OK capture: Installer (--offline) + ip-preserve verified on 3 clouds + runbook + model pinning + canary rollback. Also need security checklist (no KMS = doc). Will we add quantization/optimized runtime later.

ben_eng: I'll open spike ticket and include perf regression tests. For offline bundle we'll provide CLI: `redwood-installer --offline --no-telemetry` and artifact tarball. Need to confirm size constraints (~500MB target).

cara_field: Field checklist: network preflight steps, IP allocation docs, contact point for rollback, and SLA expectations. I'll draft preflight doc.

alex_pm: Action items: ben -> spike + PR template by Fri 03/12, cara -> preflight doc draft by Wed, dan -> identify 2 pilot customers & schedule. I'll update roadmap afterwards. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder: kickoff meeting scheduled for 1716010200 (calendar invite sent) :calendar:

ben_eng: ack — will update ticket.
